name: plvs
description: PLVS — real-time audio metering desktop app (Peak / Loudness / Vectorscope / Spectrum)

scripts.website:test: vitest run website/ scripts/build-user-docs.test.mjs scripts/build-sharesets-site.test.js scripts/validate-website.test.mjs scripts/websiteReleaseLinks.test.js scripts/profile-presentation.test.js scripts/preset-presentation.test.js scripts/documentationStructure.test.js scripts/check-changes.test.js scripts/website-publication.test.js scripts/sharesetsDeploymentWorkflow.test.js
scripts.website:verify: npm run website:check && npm run website:test
scripts.check:contracts: npm run version:check && npm run licenses:check && npm run sharesets:source:check && npm run website:check && npm test
scripts.check:frontend: npm run check:contracts && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.prebuild: npm run theme:generate && npm run agent:generate
scripts.benchmark:vectorscope-rust: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && cargo bench --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bench vectorscope
scripts.benchmark:stereo-map-rust: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && cargo bench --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bench stereo_map
scripts.licenses:generate: node scripts/generate-license-inventory.mjs --write && node scripts/generate-component-notices.mjs --write && node scripts/generate-native-notices.mjs --write
scripts.licenses:check: node scripts/generate-license-inventory.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-component-notices.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-native-notices.mjs --check
scripts.rust:clippy: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:test: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.rust:check: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && npm run rust:fmt && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.check: npm run version:check && npm run licenses:check && npm run sharesets:source:check && npm run website:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run rust:check
scripts.desktop:preview-deb: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-linux-deb.mjs preview
scripts.desktop:stable-deb: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-linux-deb.mjs stable
scripts.verify:loudness-reference: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib ffmpeg_reference -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile debug --identity dev --stage && node scripts/run-tauri-dev.mjs --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json --features dev-identity
scripts.desktop:dev-optimized: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile release --identity dev --stage && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.no-updater.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json --features dev-identity
scripts.desktop:preview-dmg: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile release --identity preview --stage && tauri build --bundles dmg,app --config src-tauri/tauri.clear-resources.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.preview.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json --features preview-identity
scripts.desktop:preview-nsis: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile release --identity preview --stage && tauri build --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.preview.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json --features preview-identity
scripts.desktop:stable-nsis: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile release --identity stable --stage && tauri build --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json
scripts.desktop:stable-dmg: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile release --identity stable --stage && tauri build --bundles dmg,app --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json
scripts.desktop:check-nsis: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile release --identity stable --stage && tauri build --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.no-updater.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json
scripts.desktop:check-dmg: npm run ffmpeg:fetch && node scripts/build-plvs-cli.mjs --profile release --identity stable --stage && tauri build --bundles dmg,app --config src-tauri/tauri.no-updater.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.cli-sidecar.conf.json
